xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ExplanationForTheDeviationOrVa: Company utilized 100% of FPO Funds as contemplated under the objects of the issue set out in prospectus. However, due to default of shipyards, company rescinded 4 shipbuilding contracts. The Company received Rs.330.65 crores as refund from shipyards. The shareholders vide the resolution passed through postal ballot on 17-02-2017 approved the proposals to re-deploy the said sum for acquisition of any such vessels or towards the balance payments remaining due for the tonnage acquisition. Of the above Rs.196.80 Crores have been utilised and the company is having a balance of Rs.133.85 Crores.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CommentsOfTheAuditCommitteeAft: The same was reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee at their Meeting held on 16.05.2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:OriginalObject: For Funding 3 No's 6500 TEU Container vessels and 1 No. Bulk Carrier (4 No bulk carrier was proposed to be purchased of which only 3 nos had been purchased)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ModifiedObject: To acquire any number of offshore assets (including but not limited to AHTSV and PSV), LPG vessels and such other vessels as the Board may from time to time deem appropriate.
